content.text:
Finding submitted.

**Summary:** Section 15.11 (p0833) is the only limitation-of-liability provision in the Agreement. It gives a mutual waiver of indirect/consequential damages but contains **no aggregate monetary cap at all** — leaving PB's direct liability unlimited. Neither Article 12 (indemnification/insurance), the 13.6 disclaimer, nor 14.4.2 (exclusive remedy, which only channels SFJ's termination damages into the Section 14.2 payments) supplies a cap, and document-wide searches for "aggregate liability" / "shall not exceed" returned nothing responsive.

**Classification:** deviation — fails the fallback (mutual 12-month fees cap with carve-outs).

**Cure (fallback, one operation):** a new Section 15.11.1 imposing a mutual cap at fees paid or payable in the 12 months preceding the claim, with indemnification, confidentiality, gross negligence and willful misconduct carved out. I did not volunteer the preferred USD 1,000,000 greater-of floor or the additional preferred carve-outs, and the retained final sentence of 15.11 (preserving PB's Article 6 / 14.2 payment obligations) keeps the payment mechanics intact.
